title: mktemp -J record
description: The single record of `mktemp -J`: what it created, in place of the name it would print. Error records (`#/$defs/error`) are in the same stream. One record per line (NDJSON); version 1 of the Dogfish record format (doc/ndjson.md). Fields may be added in later releases.

action.description: What mktemp made: `create`, a new empty file (mode 0600 before the umask); `mkdir`, a directory (-d, mode 0700). Absent with -u, which makes nothing.

path.description: The name of what was made (or with -u, the name chosen), as mktemp prints it.

path_bytes.description: The bytes of `path`, base64, present only when they are not UTF-8 (`path` then holds the lossy form).

dry_run.description: Present (true) with -u: the name is unused, but nothing was created.

error.description: An error record: the structured twin of a diagnostic the tool also printed on standard error, in order with the other records.
The diagnostic as printed on standard error, without the `tool: ` prefix.

path.description: The file the diagnostic names first, as given.

path_bytes.description: The bytes of `path`, base64, present only when they are not UTF-8 (`path` then holds the lossy form).

errno.description: The system error number, when the diagnostic ends with its message (2 for `No such file or directory`).
